abilities.name: Wind Pad
abilities.text: Places an Archipelago wind pad: anyone who steps on it is launched. 20 s.

abilities.name: Static Orb

abilities.text: Low slide under fire; reload is instant during it. Recharges after 2 kills.

abilities.text: Marks 3 spots. Lightning hits each after 1.5 s for 90 damage.
